name: SERPENT_LIFTED_HIGH
canonical: A single serpent figure cast in polished golden-bronze metal, bright warm bronze colour, raised upright and standing free on a small bronze collar at the very top end of a tall straight bare wooden pole, lifted high above the desert. The serpent body rises in one upright S-curve held clear above the pole, head lifted; it sits atop the pole and is not wound or coiled around it. Plain atmospheric wilderness sky behind, reverent.
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
